get_task_runs: get the list of task runs associated with a requester from the Mephisto database
get_total_spend: get the total funding spent by a requester across all tasks and task runs
register_requester: register a new requester with the crowd provider using credentials and provider type arguments
check_available_budget: check the available funds a requester profile has for its crowdsourcing vendor
create_requester: create a new requester by name and register it in the Mephisto database
